author: Codex root
scope: design and hand derivation only; downstream owns implementation/reproduction
candidate: L: choose an interchangeable destination using current translation locality before first backend VALID
claim_boundary: The COPY_TO_POOL interface alone is not novel: io_uring provided buffers already select an output buffer and report its ID. Persistent mappings, DMA allocators and locality-aware recycling also exist. The falsifiable hypothesis is that a bounded hardware selection point can avoid real translation work under late, unobservable-to-software residency changes at lower total cost than the best software/preparation/capacity control.

workload.required: Application accepts any correctly owned destination slot from a registered output pool; completion gives the actual slot and length. Source and output must not overlap. Consumer eventually releases exactly that slot after real copy completion and cache synchronization.
examples: packet or sample collection into interchangeable receive buffers
excluded: consumer immediately copies to a required fixed address without charging that copy
workload.mapping: First design uses fixed pinned 4KiB mappings and static device contexts; each pool belongs to one SID/context. Different devices do not borrow one another's permission. Separate physical frames may prevent hugepage formation; hugepage-compatible cases remain a mandatory control.
workload.original_start: Include pool creation/registration, initial cache history and all requests producing that history equally. No model starts with a candidate-specific manufactured stall. Dynamic candidate availability and cache residency must be generated by legal COPY and consumer-release events.

action.limit: At most 4 eligible free candidates per selection; one parent per native frontend. Does not claim four pending translations or four walkers.
steps: Latch immutable source/length/options/tag and validate trusted pool membership, length and nonoverlap before any backend VALID.

Reserve completion capacity, then scan up to q=4 FREE slots round-robin. Queries are hints only: use same PSCID/GSCID/stage match and suppress replacement touches. Each serial query costs a real lookup opportunity; never trigger a page walk for an unchosen hint.

Prefer a resident eligible slot, else choose ordinary round-robin. Atomic FREE->RESERVED arbitrates simultaneous allocators. Revalidate availability; if the selected slot changed, bounded retry once then oldest ordinary candidate. No unbounded hunt for hits.
Freeze chosen destination and all parent fields before first backend VALID. No changes while VALID&&!READY, or after backend/AXI publication.

Run both READ and WRITE through unchanged normal IOMMU permission checks. Advisory state can be stale; stale hints cause misses/normal faults, never permission bypass. No pinning is required for correctness and invalidation always wins.

Only complete successful actual READ/WRITE/B permits RESERVED->DELIVERED and publication of tag,slot,length,status. Output ownership remains held until consumer release with matching generation. Full completion storage prevents new launch; it must not block an already-issued B.

Access error quarantines the destination and completes an explicit error only after legal drainage. Native NO_ERROR_HANDLING does not supply this contract; error recovery is a downstream design obligation, not a solved feature.

Pool exhaustion waits fairly without generating payload requests. Budget lookup probes against ordinary demand; age-based fallback uses a cold free slot rather than starving. Pool and slot counter wrap requires drain before reuse.
new_interfaces: advisory IOTLB probe arbitration or explicitly priced shadow tags
latched parent and selected slot state
action.no_free_information: Existing research snapshot is not a free functional interface; it lacks full authorization and any use of wide tag copies/ports must be charged.

hand_calculation.status: conditional normalized single-service-server construction, not cycles measured or a simulator run
hand_calculation.conditions: Two tasks V then A released together after identical history H. Both are 64B COPYs, no overlapping addresses. V has two interchangeable free output slots; exactly one has a valid matching resident translation. Which one is resident is hidden from an early fixed allocator. V source and A source hit; A destination misses. No eviction between V selection and its ordinary destination lookup in this construction. Two complementary residency states are equally weighted.

costs.D_definition: 2 normal translation lookup/check units + AR1 + R8 + AW1 + W8 + B1 + frontend3 = 24. 64bit payload, 8 R beats and 8 W beats per copy.
costs.M_definition: 20 extra serialized service units per cold endpoint including all required PTE requests/returns; assumed normalized total, not native measured latency.
costs.delta_definition: 2 serial hint probes + 1 reserve/commit unit + 1 additional chosen-slot report/read unit, all conservatively placed before A; actual downstream hardware/software costs must replace this assumption.

schedules.policy: balanced mean of any fixed choice without residency information
software late choose with same fresh information

hand_calculation.proof: For a pair of software-indistinguishable states with opposite resident destinations, any state-independent deterministic choice misses in one state. Randomization on an equiprobable pair also misses with probability 1/2. This is an information-timing distinction only, NOT a lower bound against software with fresh hints, prewarm+retention, a different pool allocator or a changed capacity budget.
hand_calculation.break_even: E[avoidance gain] = p_miss*M - delta. Here 0.5*20-4=6 units. Compare both tasks: means (34,78)->(28,72); if early choice is hot, candidate is worse by4 for both. Oracle software with delta_sw<=delta matches or beats the candidate.
hand_calculation.all_work: Two COPY descriptors, four actual endpoint permissions, 16 source R data beats,16 destination W beats,2 AR,2 AW,2 B; probe requests add metadata/port time but no permissions or data transactions for unchosen slots. Registration/H, CPU ownership/cache work, output slot report and all A work count. No payload is removed and no free data bandwidth is added.
hand_calculation.joint_metrics: Report (V,A), makespan, aggregate useful bytes/time, weighted normalized slowdowns and Jain fairness; mean pair alone is not a tail guarantee.
hand_calculation.reachability_gap: The complementary cache states are a premise to be generated and checked using native 16-way PLRU, masks, actual iDMA queues and legal whole COPY traces. They have not been shown reachable on this platform. If software-visible release order predicts residency just as well, this positive distinction disappears.

strong_controls: round-robin, FIFO, LIFO and most-recent-released buffer selection on identical pools
page-grouped and hugepage-aware allocation following IOTLB-wall work, persistent mapped DAMN-style pools; charge different physical memory requirements
software late buffer selection plus same advisory query; measure its actual unhidden cost, not a forced syscall or interrupt
complete prepare of all current candidates / one-page WRITE lookahead with retention; all extra PTE work, holding time and initialization counted; allow overlap with source/data and reuse
same total bit/port budget spent on more IOTLB entries, context cache or genuine outstanding resources; static/dynamic P/N allocation including impact on A
ordinary hardware hit-first pool allocator using same interface: intentionally the simplest implementation of this candidate, not an allegedly defeated control
extra DDR buffers and batching; allow legal cheaper layout changes instead of forcing candidate's fragmented layout
counterexamples: All candidates hit, all miss, or only one candidate is free: no avoided miss; probes are overhead.
CPU has fresh equivalent residency feedback cheaply: software matches.
Cold miss is fully hidden by native nonblocking traffic or another bottleneck: reduced PTE count does not improve completion.
Fixed/hugepage/reserved mapping covers the pool at comparable total cost: the premise disappears.
Consumer needs a fixed address and copies the output there: extra COPY can cost more than saved walk.
Permission/context changes or another lookup evicts chosen entry before real use: correctness remains normal but performance can vanish.
Hot buffer remains consumer-owned or has wrong access rights: it must not be selected.

costs.configuration: Reference F=4 pools/frontends, P=64 slots/pool, q=4 hints/window; example is a budget layout, not synthesized area.
costs.ownership_bits: F*P*(state2+slot_generation32)=8704; if an implementation relies on trusted exactly-once release to omit generations, compare the same contract and count software state explicitly.
costs.total_bits: 11387+4O; O=32 illustrative =>11515 bits, ceil=1440B. Packing/ECC/pipeline buffers and any extra full tag/PA shadow are additional. Existing DMA buffers/8 heads/32 TC write words are not part of this metadata total and remain equal.
costs.ports: Reuse one IOTLB lookup port: up to4 cycles and interference to ordinary traffic; a parallel alternative adds4*16 comparisons, routing and context checks rather than being free. Ownership allocator needs atomic reserve and release arbitration; completion capacity for already-issued tasks mandatory.
costs.critical_path: Keep selection ahead of parent VALID and register the chosen address; no allocator combinational path through AXI ready/valid. A shadow directory needs consistency updates/flush handling but only supplies hints.
costs.software_memory: Reference pool owns4*64*4KiB=1MiB DDR if slots are pages; compare identical pool and compact/subpage alternatives. OS pinning, mappings, cache synchronization, free bookkeeping, CPU register traffic and pointer indirection are explicit costs.
costs.threshold: 1440B may buy substantial ordinary IOTLB capacity. If a same-budget ordinary capacity increase solves the working set with less end-to-end cost, stop this architecture in that range.

decision: Keep as a falsifiable interface/cost hypothesis, not a proved independent contribution. If native reachable hidden-state variation yields p_miss*M greater than full overhead and strongest existing allocation/preparation/capacity controls cannot reproduce the benefit at same total cost, and further primary-source review does not cover this current-state selection action, this can support an independent mechanism contribution.

search_value_boundary.derivation: Uniformly sample q distinct free destinations out of N, h of which currently have matching resident translations. Early random selection misses with 1-h/N; q probes all miss with binom(N-h,q)/binom(N,q). Expected saved translation work is their difference times M. This assumes stationary residency during scan, no permission mismatch, and no data-path hiding.
search_value_boundary.consequence: Do not select uniform-random large pools as presumed positive workloads. A useful domain needs sufficiently concentrated eligible choices and unpredictable residual residency relative to the best LIFO/page-local software policy, or a substantially larger unhidden M. Huge pools dilute hit probability while making ownership metadata expensive.
search_value_boundary.strong_control_boundary: Replace early-random miss probability by the measured miss probability of the best cheap software allocator. The proof against state-independent choices does not establish a gap against a good correlated allocator.
search_value_boundary.rule_refinement: q is a cap, not a required scan length. Stop on first acceptable hit; disable extra probes when recent paired evidence estimates saved unhidden work below probe/ownership/report cost. Budget adaptation is ordinary value-of-information control and is not claimed novel. The table above charges all q probes as a conservative fixed-scan variant; early-stop variants must recalculate expected overhead.
search_value_boundary.evidence: Closed-form arithmetic evaluated directly; no workload model, simulator or RTL run.
